name: overlays/drawer
title: Drawer
description: A sheet from the edge that you can drag away.

files.content:
export { Drawer } from './Drawer';
export type { DrawerProps } from './Drawer';

keyboard.action: Move through the drawer’s controls; wraps inside it.
Close the drawer and return focus to its trigger.

notes: A native modal `<dialog>` labelled by its title; the page behind is inert while it is open.
Dragging is an enhancement for pointer users. Every way of closing has a keyboard and a button equivalent (WCAG 2.5.7).
Drags that start on a button, link or field are ignored, so controls inside keep working.
Focus moves into the drawer on open and back to the opener on close.
accessibility.reducedMotion: The sheet appears at once instead of sliding, and does not glide back after a short drag.
